listing.name: Yo-kai Watch 4++ (YW4Recomp)
listing.summary: An early Yo-kai Watch 4++ project translating ARM main/sdk code to C with Clang and native Vulkan services. It claims no linked emulator code; Eden is a visual reference only. The project reports startup, a new game, house/town/menus and autosaving at 30 FPS, with missing effects and crashes beyond tested areas. There is no release: local preparation needs Python, Git, Clang, GCC and the Vulkan SDK for input, translation, shaders and building. Windows x64 Vulkan 1.3 is built/tested; Linux x64 is planned and untested despite its badge, with no Mac route. Supply your own exact hash-checked 4++ update 2.2.0 ExeFS/RomFS, rather than generic original Yo-kai Watch 4. Exact hashes/title/region and separate keys/firmware needs are unspecified in the root guide. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
